# BobloUI 0.11.5-beta.1

Load:
local BobloUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet(URL))()
local UI = BobloUI:CreateWindow({Id="hub", Title="Hub"})
local Tab = UI:AddTab({Id="main", Title="Main"})
local Section = Tab:AddSection({Title="Automation"})

Constructors:
- AddButton({...}) — Action button.
- AddToggle({...}) — Boolean switch bound to State.
- AddSlider({...}) — Numeric slider.
- AddDropdown({...}) — Single or multi-select dropdown.
- AddInput({...}) — Text or numeric input.
- AddKeybind({...}) — Chord-capable keyboard/mobile binding with custom modes.
- AddColorPicker({...}) — Color selector with HEX/RGB entry.
- AddParagraph({...}) — Rich explanatory text; omit Title for label-like text.
- AddDivider({...}) — Visual separator with optional title.
- AddStatus({...}) — Read-only live status indicator; may read State by Id but is never persisted.
- AddProgress({...}) — Determinate or indeterminate progress bar.
- AddCode({...}) — Read-only code block with optional copy action.
- AddImage({...}) — Image/media block using Roblox asset content.
- AddPassthrough({...}) — Host an existing Roblox GuiObject.
- AddViewport({...}) — Interactive 3D ViewportFrame control.
- AddVideo({...}) — VideoFrame control with playback API.

Common control methods: GetValue, SetValue, Reset, CopyValue, PasteValue (when clipboard read is available), SetTitle, SetDescription, SetVisible, SetDisabled, SetLoading, SetBadge, Highlight, Reveal, OnChanged, Destroy. Some stateless presentation controls intentionally expose only meaningful methods; see llms-full.txt.

State: UI.State:Get/Set/Update/Watch/WatchMany/Batch/Reset/Snapshot.
Dependencies: VisibleWhen={OtherId=true} or VisibleWhen=function(State) return State:Get("OtherId") end. Controls, Sections, Rows and TabBoxes support reactive visibility/enabled state.
Config: UI.Config exists only when ConfigFolder is set; Save/Load/List/Delete/Rename/Duplicate/Export/Import/SetAutoLoad/LoadAuto.
Palette: UI:OpenSearch(), UI:OpenCommands(); Ctrl+K; prefixes > commands, @ tabs, # configs, * favorites.
Layout: Sections support Icon, Span="Auto"|1|2 and Layout="Stack"|"Grid"|"Auto"; controls support Adaptive=true. Tabs support Group.
Appearance: Dark/Light built-ins, saved custom themes, custom 26-color palettes plus scrim alpha, WCAG-derived foregrounds, runtime font, sidebar width, compact mode and granular animations.
Icons: 1,756 bundled Lucide names through Icon="sword". The two BobloScript-owned PNG atlases are cached from GitHub and registered as executor-local assets; use BobloUI.Icon.List/Has/Resolve/GetStatus/Retry. Asset-free fallback icons remain available.
Navigation: keyboard Tab/Shift+Tab and gamepad D-pad/A/B; keybinds support modifier chords, custom modes, attachment and mobile HUD actions.
Data sources: Dropdown Source can be a getter/function or BobloUI.Sources.Players({...}); dictionary Values with Multi=true use map results unless MultiValueMode="Array".
HUD: UI:SetWatermark, UI:SetKeybindHUD; draggable labels/buttons/menus are public overlays. Loading supports stages, error actions and a control sidebar.
Window extras: UI:AddTopbarButton, UI:AddTopbarTag, UI:SetFooterText, UI:SetSidebarWidth, UI:SetCompact, UI:SetFont, UI:SetAnimations, UI:SetResponsiveThresholds, UI:SetSearchbarSize, UI:SetTabSwipe and media/background APIs.
Settings: built-in Settings tab includes themes, config profiles, favorites, keybinds, accessibility and window preferences.
Declarative: UI:Build({Tabs={...}}) validates the complete descriptor before creating anything.

RULES
- Only the constructors listed above exist. There is NO AddLabel, AddMultiDropdown or AddTextbox.
- Multi-select uses AddDropdown({Multi=true}).
- Every stateful control intended for State/Config needs a globally unique Id.
- Sections are created on Tabs. Controls may also be added directly to a Tab (implicit section).
- Use documented methods, not internal fields.

# Component reference

## Button / AddButton
Action button.

Stateful: no

Options:
- Id: string?
- Title: string? (required)
- Description: string?
- Keywords: table?
- Badge: string?
- Disabled: boolean|string?
- Visible: boolean?
- VisibleWhen: table|function?
- EnabledWhen: table|function?
- IgnoreConfig: boolean?
- Order: number?
- Callback: function?
- Tooltip: string|function?
- ContextMenu: table?
- Adaptive: boolean?
- Icon: string?
- IconColor: string|Color3?
- Text: string?
- Variant: string?
- Confirm: string?
- Risky: boolean?
- DoubleClick: boolean?
- DoubleClickWindow: number?
- SubButtons: table?
- Actions: table?

Specific methods:
- Click — Programmatically invoke the button action.
- AddAction — Append an attached sub-action button.
- AddKeybind — Attach a Keybind control to this button.

## Toggle / AddToggle
Boolean switch bound to State.

Stateful: yes

Options:
- Id: string?
- Title: string? (required)
- Description: string?
- Keywords: table?
- Badge: string?
- Disabled: boolean|string?
- Visible: boolean?
- VisibleWhen: table|function?
- EnabledWhen: table|function?
- IgnoreConfig: boolean?
- Order: number?
- Callback: function?
- Tooltip: string|function?
- ContextMenu: table?
- Adaptive: boolean?
- Icon: string?
- IconColor: string|Color3?
- Default: boolean?
- Style: string?

Specific methods:
- Flip — Invert the current boolean value.

## Slider / AddSlider
Numeric slider.

Stateful: yes

Options:
- Id: string?
- Title: string? (required)
- Description: string?
- Keywords: table?
- Badge: string?
- Disabled: boolean|string?
- Visible: boolean?
- VisibleWhen: table|function?
- EnabledWhen: table|function?
- IgnoreConfig: boolean?
- Order: number?
- Callback: function?
- Tooltip: string|function?
- ContextMenu: table?
- Adaptive: boolean?
- Icon: string?
- IconColor: string|Color3?
- Min: number (required)
- Max: number (required)
- Default: number?
- Step: number?
- Precision: number?
- Rounding: number?
- Prefix: string?
- Suffix: string?
- Format: function?
- FormatDisplayValue: function?
- ValueInput: boolean?
- AllowRightClickInput: boolean?
- FloatingValue: boolean?
- Compact: boolean?
- HideMax: boolean?
- IconFrom: string?
- IconTo: string?

Specific methods:
- SetMin — Change the minimum and clamp the current value.
- SetMax — Change the maximum and clamp the current value.
- SetStep — Change the numeric step.
- SetPrefix — Change the displayed prefix.
- SetSuffix — Change the displayed suffix.

## Dropdown / AddDropdown
Single or multi-select dropdown.

Stateful: yes

Options:
- Id: string?
- Title: string? (required)
- Description: string?
- Keywords: table?
- Badge: string?
- Disabled: boolean|string?
- Visible: boolean?
- VisibleWhen: table|function?
- EnabledWhen: table|function?
- IgnoreConfig: boolean?
- Order: number?
- Callback: function?
- Tooltip: string|function?
- ContextMenu: table?
- Adaptive: boolean?
- Icon: string?
- IconColor: string|Color3?
- Options: table?
- Values: table?
- Default: any?
- Multi: boolean?
- MultiValueMode: string?
- Map: boolean?
- ReturnMap: boolean?
- Searchable: boolean?
- AllowNone: boolean?
- AllowNull: boolean?
- Max: number?
- Placeholder: string?
- Style: string?
- Source: any?
- MaxVisibleRows: number?
- MaxVisibleDropdownItems: number?
- DragSelect: boolean?
- DisabledValues: table?
- ValueImages: table?
- Images: table?
- FormatDisplayValue: function?
- FormatListValue: function?
- FormatValue: function?
- FormatOption: function?

Specific methods:
- SetOptions — Replace all choices.
- SetValues — Replace all choices from an array or dictionary.
- AddOption — Append one choice.
- AddValues — Append or merge choices.
- RemoveOption — Remove a choice by value.
- Refresh — Refresh the open list or replace choices.
- Open — Open the picker.
- Close — Close the picker.
- SetDisabledValues — Replace disabled value list.
- AddDisabledValues — Append one or more disabled values.
- SetValueDisabled — Disable or enable one value.
- SetValueImage — Set one value image.
- SetValueImages — Replace the value image map.
- AddValueImages — Merge entries into the value image map.
- SetDragSelect — Enable or disable multi-value drag selection.
- GetActiveValues — Read the selected value set or its count.
- SetMaxVisibleRows — Set popup row limit.
- SetFormatters — Set display and list formatters.

Text or numeric input.

Stateful: yes

Options:
- Id: string?
- Title: string? (required)
- Description: string?
- Keywords: table?
- Badge: string?
- Disabled: boolean|string?
- Visible: boolean?
- VisibleWhen: table|function?
- EnabledWhen: table|function?
- IgnoreConfig: boolean?
- Order: number?
- Callback: function?
- Tooltip: string|function?
- ContextMenu: table?
- Adaptive: boolean?
- Icon: string?
- IconColor: string|Color3?
- Default: string|number?
- Placeholder: string?
- Numeric: boolean?
- MaxLength: number?
- Multiline: boolean?
- ClearOnFocus: boolean?
- ClearTextOnFocus: boolean?
- ClearTextOnBlur: boolean?
- AllowEmpty: boolean?
- EmptyReset: string|number?
- Validate: function?
- VerifyValue: function?
- Finished: boolean?
- CommitOn: string?
- Height: number?

Specific methods:
- Focus — Capture text focus.
- Blur — Release text focus.
- Clear — Reset to an empty string or zero.
- SetAllowEmpty — Enable or disable empty values and optionally change the reset value.
- SetError — Show or clear a validation error state.

## Keybind / AddKeybind
Chord-capable keyboard/mobile binding with custom modes.

Stateful: yes

Options:
- Id: string?
- Title: string? (required)
- Description: string?
- Keywords: table?
- Badge: string?
- Disabled: boolean|string?
- Visible: boolean?
- VisibleWhen: table|function?
- EnabledWhen: table|function?
- IgnoreConfig: boolean?
- Order: number?
- Callback: function?
- Tooltip: string|function?
- ContextMenu: table?
- Adaptive: boolean?
- Icon: string?
- IconColor: string|Color3?
- Default: any?
- Mode: string?
- AllowedModes: table?
- Blacklist: table?
- Blacklisted: table?
- Whitelist: table?
- Whitelisted: table?
- Modifiers: table?
- DefaultModifiers: table?
- ModifierWhitelist: table?
- WhitelistedModifiers: table?
- ModifierBlacklist: table?
- BlacklistModifiers: table?
- BlacklistedModifiers: table?
- ExactModifiers: boolean?
- CustomModes: table?
- Modes: table?
- AttachTo: any?
- SyncToggle: boolean?
- SyncToggleState: boolean?
- WaitForCallback: boolean?
- ChangedCallback: function?
- Clicked: function?
- NoUI: boolean?
- Mobile: boolean?
- MobileText: string?
- ShowInHUD: boolean?

Specific methods:
- SetMode — Change Toggle/Hold/Always mode.
- IsActive — Return current active state.
- Capture — Capture the next key.
- Cancel — Cancel key capture.
- Focus — Alias of Capture for keyboard focus semantics.
- SetKey — Set primary key and optional modifiers.
- SetModifiers — Replace modifier chord.
- GetModifiers — Read modifier chord.
- Attach — Attach this binding to a control.
- Trigger — Trigger from touch or code.
